strings.name: Mohammed bin Salman
strings.summary: Mohammed bin Salman studied law at King Saud University before becoming his father’s adviser, defence minister and crown prince, then prime minister in 2022. His Vision 2030 promotes economic diversification and social policy changes while power has become more concentrated. The Yemen war, repression of dissent and Khashoggi’s killing remain central controversies; he denies ordering the killing.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Promotes Saudi economic transformation and social policy changes; his energy, investment and regional security decisions have global influence.

strings.highlights.h1.title: Vision 2030
strings.highlights.h1.text: Promotes investment and tourism to reduce oil dependence.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Social policy changes
strings.highlights.h2.text: Several women’s-rights activists were detained before the driving ban ended in 2018.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Prime minister
strings.timeline.t1.text: Appointed prime minister while remaining crown prince.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Khashoggi intelligence assessment
strings.timeline.t2.text: US intelligence assessed he approved capture or killing; he denied personal responsibility.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Driving ban lifted
strings.timeline.t3.text: Saudi Arabia ended the ban after arresting several women activists.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Crown prince
strings.timeline.t4.text: Replaced Mohammed bin Nayef as heir to the throne.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Vision 2030 announced
strings.timeline.t5.text: Unveiled an economic plan to reduce oil revenue dependence.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Defence minister
strings.timeline.t6.text: Appointed after his father’s accession; Saudi-led intervention in Yemen followed.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Adviser to his father
strings.timeline.t7.text: Became formal adviser to Salman, then Riyadh governor.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in Riyadh
strings.timeline.t8.text: Born into the Saudi royal family; later studied law locally.
